cards.back:
To move on your feet at a normal speed.
Bahasa Indonesia: berjalan
Example: We walk to school together.
cards.say: walk. To move on your feet at a normal speed. We walk to school together.

cards.back:
To move on your feet very fast.
Bahasa Indonesia: berlari
Example: The dog runs after the ball.
cards.say: run. To move on your feet very fast. The dog runs after the ball.

cards.back:
To push yourself off the ground.
Bahasa Indonesia: melompat
Example: The frog can jump far.
cards.say: jump. To push yourself off the ground. The frog can jump far.

cards.back:
To jump on one foot, or like a rabbit.
Bahasa Indonesia: melompat satu kaki
Example: The rabbit can hop in the grass.
cards.say: hop. To jump on one foot, or like a rabbit. The rabbit can hop in the grass.

cards.back:
To move with a small jump on each foot.
Bahasa Indonesia: melompat-lompat kecil
Example: The girls skip to the park.
cards.say: skip. To move with a small jump on each foot. The girls skip to the park.

cards.back:
To go up something like a tree or wall.
Bahasa Indonesia: memanjat
Example: The boy can climb a tall tree.
cards.say: climb. To go up something like a tree or wall. The boy can climb a tall tree.

cards.back:
To move on your hands and knees.
Bahasa Indonesia: merangkak
Example: The baby can crawl on the floor.
cards.say: crawl. To move on your hands and knees. The baby can crawl on the floor.

cards.back:
To move through water.
Bahasa Indonesia: berenang
Example: The fish swim in the river.
cards.say: swim. To move through water. The fish swim in the river.

cards.back:
To move through the air.
Bahasa Indonesia: terbang
Example: The birds fly over the rice field.
cards.say: fly. To move through the air. The birds fly over the rice field.

cards.back:
To turn over and over.
Bahasa Indonesia: menggelinding
Example: The ball rolls down the hill.
cards.say: roll. To turn over and over. The ball rolls down the hill.

cards.back:
To move smoothly across a surface.
Bahasa Indonesia: meluncur
Example: The children slide down the slope.
cards.say: slide. To move smoothly across a surface. The children slide down the slope.

cards.back:
To move round to face another way.
Bahasa Indonesia: berbelok atau berputar
Example: Turn left at the corner.
cards.say: turn. To move round to face another way. Turn left at the corner.

cards.back:
To go behind someone.
Bahasa Indonesia: mengikuti
Example: The ducklings follow their mother.
cards.say: follow. To go behind someone. The ducklings follow their mother.

cards.back:
To run after someone to catch them.
Bahasa Indonesia: mengejar
Example: The cat chases a mouse.
cards.say: chase. To run after someone to catch them. The cat chases a mouse.

cards.back:
To go by something.
Bahasa Indonesia: melewati
Example: The bus passes our house.
cards.say: pass. To go by something. The bus passes our house.

cards.back:
To go from one side to the other.
Bahasa Indonesia: menyeberang
Example: We cross the road at the crossing.
cards.say: cross. To go from one side to the other. We cross the road at the crossing.

cards.back:
To go into a place.
Bahasa Indonesia: masuk
Example: Please enter the room quietly.
cards.say: enter. To go into a place. Please enter the room quietly.

cards.back:
To go away from a place.
Bahasa Indonesia: meninggalkan
Example: We leave home at seven.
cards.say: leave. To go away from a place. We leave home at seven.

cards.back:
To get to a place.
Bahasa Indonesia: tiba
Example: The train arrives at noon.
cards.say: arrive. To get to a place. The train arrives at noon.

cards.back:
To not move any more.
Bahasa Indonesia: berhenti
Example: The bus stops at the corner.
cards.say: stop. To not move any more. The bus stops at the corner.

cards.back:
To let go so that something goes down.
Bahasa Indonesia: menjatuhkan
Example: Do not drop the glass.
cards.say: drop. To let go so that something goes down. Do not drop the glass.

cards.back:
To hold something and take it with you.
Bahasa Indonesia: membawa
Example: I carry my bag to school.
cards.say: carry. To hold something and take it with you. I carry my bag to school.

cards.back:
To pick something up to a higher place.
Bahasa Indonesia: mengangkat
Example: He can lift the heavy box.
cards.say: lift. To pick something up to a higher place. He can lift the heavy box.
